entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • System.Drawing.Common pruning leads to a compile error when only UseWPF is specified #51173
  • [NETSDKE2E] Workload Installation Fails with 10.0.100-rc.2.25502.107 #51166

Closed

  • [dotnet watch] Cannot open project Lib.fsproj because extension fsproj is not associated with a language #46378
  • "dotnet package update" modifies wrong project file (csproj) #51012
  • dotnet package add --file inserts package reference before shebang in C# scripts #51171
  • The SDK should suppress strong-name checking (CS8002) when targeting .NET TFMs #51168

PullRequests

Created

  • Disable failing test on non-Windows #51172
  • Fail the RPM build if FPM tool is not present #51170

Merged

  • [dotnet-watch] Auto-restart project on runtime rude edit #51073
  • Refactor DotnetInstall types #51140
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51163
  • Update MSTest to stable 4.0.0 #51167
  • Handle hardlinks with file-based app csc optimization #51135
    Area-run-file, 10.0.2xx

Updated

  • Support variables in `#:project` directives #51108
    Area-run-file, 10.0.2xx
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50946
    Area-NuGet, Area-FSharp
  • Avoid exceptions when parsing _NormalizedWindowsSdkSupportedTargetPlatformVersion #51134
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #50886
    Branch Lockdown
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #51026
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #51155
  • Add support for creating and editing solution filter (.slnf) files from the CLI #51156
  • Add GitHub Copilot agents to automate XLF updates and completion test fixes #51158
  • dnup code review #50988
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix `--project` and `--solution` descriptions for `dotnet test` MTP to use "test" instead of "run" and extract shared localization strings #51052
    Servicing-consider
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51143
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-Roslyn
  • Throw Error When Adding Projects with the Same Name but Different Paths to Solution Folder #51131
    Area-CLI
